featured_reviews.name: AYUSH INGOLE
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited this health care centre with my father on 12/09/2025 for a consultation, and unfortunately, our experience was very disappointing. Although we had arrived earlier, another patient who came after us was allowed to see the doctor first, even though he also did not have a token. When my father raised this concern, the doctor responded rudely and loudly referred us to the board about taking tokens.

When it was finally our turn, I politely suggested that the hospital create a proper window or system for issuing tokens to avoid such confusion in the future. Instead of taking this as constructive feedback, the doctor reacted defensively, raised his voice, accused me of arguing with him, and even said: “If you want to come to me, come; if not, then don’t.”

I want to make it clear, I could also have been rude and disrespectful in response, but I chose not to. Out of respect, I controlled myself and avoided creating a scene. However, patients deserve to be treated with courtesy, fairness, and professionalism. Clear procedures and respectful communication would greatly improve the hospital experience for everyone.
(I controlled myself very well otherwise I can also increase my voice louder than him for sure.)
